worldcombat.skill.quickattack.summary: Burst a short distance along your aim, strike as your body reaches the target, and stop sharply. Eager form starts sooner and travels slightly farther, with less power and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.use.0: Win the first exchange while the foe has not moved yet
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.use.1: Finish a weakened target at almost no cost
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.use.2: Close a short gap when you cannot catch up
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.descriptio: The lunge deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

Dash up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; it stops at the first creature in its path, shoving it about %3$s blocks if it is not friendly. It never pierces, and comes up empty if nothing is struck.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.eager.on: Eager form: 1 tick faster off the mark (instant at best) and 7% further, but a tenth lighter and 4 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.eager.off: Grounded form: a solid charge, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown, with standard preparation and reach.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.growth.0: At level %1$s the lunge rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.growth.1: At level %1$s the lunge rises to %2$s and the dash to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.quickattack.preference: On: 1 tick faster off the mark (instant at best) and 7% further, at the cost of a tenth less power and 4 ticks more cooldown. Off: a solid charge, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown.
It only charges targets within this distance; the dash is short, so larger values usually still mean walking in first.
On: prefer this hit when the target is below three tenths health, since it comes out fastest. Off: it only competes as an ordinary first-strike option.
